stories.summary_en: An international research team developed AI models that could improve long-term flood forecasting, giving communities warnings weeks before floods. The findings could inform flood risk management and disaster preparedness.

stories.value_added: Could provide flood warnings weeks ahead of floods, improving long-term flood forecasting.

sources.title_en: Hugo Morán defends Ibero-American cooperation to improve disaster prevention

summaries_original.es: En una reunión en Madrid de responsables de agua, meteorología y protección civil, presidida por el presidente de AEMET, se destacó compartir capacidades técnicas, reforzar los sistemas de alerta temprana y aprovechar la inteligencia artificial para anticipar sequías, inundaciones y otros fenómenos extremos.

stories.summary_en: At a meeting in Madrid of water, meteorology and civil protection leaders chaired by the president of AEMET, participants stressed sharing technical capacities, strengthening early warning systems and using artificial intelligence to anticipate droughts, floods and other extreme events. AI is mentioned as a future-oriented opportunity rather than a specific deployed system.
stories.title: Hugo Morán defends Ibero-American cooperation to improve disaster prevention

sources.title: Reliable AI Sea Ice Forecasts Depend on Sustained Observations
sources.title_en: Reliable AI Sea Ice Forecasts Depend on Sustained Observations

stories.summary_en: The article argues that AI-based sea ice prediction systems need sustained in-situ observations for validation. It cites an on-ice measurement campaign in the Southern Ocean supported by the Korean icebreaker R/V Araon conducted by KOPRI. The item concerns AI sea ice forecasting, which is a weather/climate-related application, though the snippet is brief.
stories.title: Reliable AI Sea Ice Forecasts Depend on Sustained Observations

sources.title_en: Tokyo workshop charts practical pathways for emerging technologies in disaster risk reduction

sources.title: World: Tokyo workshop charts practical pathways for emerging technologies in disaster risk reduction
sources.title_en: World: Tokyo workshop charts practical pathways for emerging technologies in disaster risk reduction

stories.summary_en: UNDRR, with support from the Government of Japan and JICA, convened governments, technology companies, researchers and international organizations in Tokyo on 1-2 October 2026 to discuss how AI and other emerging technologies can become practical disaster risk reduction tools. The workshop focused on pathways from technology to applied use in disaster risk reduction.
stories.title: World: Tokyo workshop charts practical pathways for emerging technologies in disaster risk reduction
stories.value_added: Explores how artificial intelligence and other emerging technologies can be translated into practical tools for reducing disaster risk.

sources.title: Bringing the surface ocean into the AIFS
sources.title_en: Bringing the surface ocean into the AIFS

stories.summary_en: ECMWF announces an extension of its AIFS machine-learning forecasting system that jointly models the atmosphere, ocean waves, sea ice and the surface ocean. The system integrates these components within one ML model, extending AI-based forecasting beyond the atmosphere to marine and ice conditions.
stories.title: Bringing the surface ocean into the AIFS
stories.value_added: Joint machine-learning model covering the atmosphere, waves, sea ice and the surface ocean in a single system.

sources.title: Diagnosing region-specific flood influencing factors in a volcanic island using explainable machine learning
sources.title_en: Diagnosing region-specific flood influencing factors in a volcanic island using explainable machine learning

stories.summary_en: A study applies a grid-based, explainable machine learning framework to Jeju Island, Republic of Korea, to diagnose flood-influencing factors. It finds rainfall, groundwater and proximity to water bodies are key and regionally variable, supporting more targeted flood risk management.
stories.title: Diagnosing region-specific flood influencing factors in a volcanic island using explainable machine learning
stories.value_added: Identifies region-specific key factors (rainfall, groundwater, proximity to water bodies) driving flood occurrence to support more nuanced flood risk management.
